title: Luxe Consumer IQ
author: Emilia Simonin
description: Welcome to Luxe Consumer IQ — the podcast that reveals how modern luxury really works. Hosted by Emilia Simonin, a former Insights Director and global consumer & market intelligence leader with senior experience at L’Oréal and LVMH’s Moët Hennessy, the series decodes the psychology, strategy, and consumer intelligence behind the world’s most influential luxury brands. For ambitious professionals ready to elevate their thinking, your next level starts here.
